entries.title: Reviewer Cascade State
entries.owner: reviewer transient-failure backoff and route selection
entries.compatibility: Settlement performs no resolver probe: it records failures and applies ordinary bounded escalation at the five-failure threshold. After durable backoff, poll-time probes run only below the infrastructure cap. Each repository discovery pass shares one watcher-context result per CLI. A healthy probe re-queues the exact observed open row and clears all claim columns; it preserves the failure streak and budgets. A failed probe schedules a load-aware hold and ends processing for that row in the same tick. Both observations preserve failure breakdowns and reasons. At the infrastructure cap, probes are bypassed so existing cap alerts and scheduled recovery remain authoritative. Resolution backoff scales with host load; a changed failure class or a gap over one hour beyond the scheduled nextRetryAfter starts a fresh streak. Watcher probes are advisory: they do not reproduce credential-staged spawn environments or Gemini antigravity selection. Only a successful review clears failure history. Existing durable field shapes and credential-outage boundaries are unchanged. Pre-model github-budget-deferred uses existing lastFailureModel/lastFailureAt/nextRetryAfter fields without incrementing counters. Its exact-reset hold applies only to the deferred model; existing routing may select another model before reset.
